name: resync-previous-head-unheld-algorithm
note: `H T Q R`: `R` a resync item at its true offset, reached by framing, of `registry_version` 2 and `hash_algorithm` 99, which the reader does not hold, whose `lineage` is `present` with a `previous_head` of 8 bytes and an `ordinal` of 0: `lineage` is judged as the header's row, so for this reader `previous_head` is `bytes` of any length and no `wrong_length` is made; the first violation in the order of the bytes is the `ordinal`: `malformed_value` `out_of_range`, and the item is `unreadable` (P1 2.4a THE RULES OF THE FIELDS, P1-23)
